mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.tenant WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tenant (id, name, schema_name, status, created_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, gen_random_uuid()), #{name}, #{schemaName}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.data_source ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, db_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, port INTEGER NOT NULL, database_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, password_encrypted VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'DISCONNECTED', created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.metadata_schema ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), data_source_id UUID REFERENCES ${schemaName}.data_source(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.metadata_table ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), schema_id UUID REFERENCES ${schemaName}.metadata_schema(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description TEXT, row_count_estimate BIGINT DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.metadata_column ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), table_id UUID REFERENCES ${schemaName}.metadata_table(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, data_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, is_nullable BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, is_primary_key BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, is_foreign_key BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, referenced_table VARCHAR(100), referenced_column VARCHAR(100), description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.ingestion_job ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), data_source_id UUID REFERENCES ${schemaName}.data_source(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, ended_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, log_message TEXT )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.domain ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, data_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, length INTEGER, precision_val INTEGER, format_pattern VARCHAR(100), description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.forbidden_word ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, word VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, replacement VARCHAR(100), description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.standard_word ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, logical_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, physical_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, domain_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES ${schemaName}.domain(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${schemaName}.standard_term ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.tenant(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, logical_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, physical_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, description TEXT, word_ids TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
